text:
maria: Heads up — invoice preview for tenant `tenant_xyz` spiked ~45% this hour, looks correlated with fallback routing hitting the shadow ingest. Anyone else seeing duplicate credits?
aj: saw it, noticed a handful of 409 retries from the ingest proxy. looks like some retries resend without an idempotency key.
devon: confirmed. fallback path swaps the route_hint and drops the original req_id in a small percentage of cases (race when session swaps). ledger join then treats it as a new session -> double credits.
ben: i reproduced locally by forcing the proxy to replay with a new route_id. dedupe currently uses `hash(req_id + route_id)`. fallback changing route_id breaks it.
katie: quick idea: propagate an `x-original-reqid` from the edge and prefer that for dedupe if present. keeps dedupe stable across route changes.
aj: we also need a telemetry card for this — metric like `meter.ingest.duplicate_count` with dimensions [tenant, route, fallback_reason]. canary alert if duplicate rate > 0.5% over 5m.
maria: agree on propagation. aj — can you sketch the dashboard? also thinking we could smooth invoice-preview numbers by applying an ephemeral dedupe window in preview pipeline (30s) so customers don't see transient spikes.
devon: be cautious with smoothing. it hides real regressions. i'd prefer fix at source + short-term preview heuristic that surfaces potential dedupe masking as a warning flag rather than hiding numbers.
ben: i'll open an infra PR to preserve x-original-reqid through the router and set canonical_reqid before enqueue. canary to 5% traffic, watch duplicates + latency.
katie: add test cases: replay with swapped routes, ensure dedupe key stable. also add an integration test that asserts invoice-preview and final-invoice align within expected tolerance after dedupe.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: infra-pr #2123 canary -> 2026-03-25T08:00:00Z.
maria: action items: ben -> PR + canary, aj -> dashboard + alert, devon -> preview smoothing tradeoff doc, katie -> tests. tagging owners @ben @aj @devon @katie.
ben: on it, will ping when PR merged :thumbsup:
aj: will prototype dashboard this afternoon and post a link here.
katie: writing tests now, will attach junit on PR.
devon: drafting preview tradeoff notes, will drop in the docs channel.
maria: thanks team — aim to have canary up tomorrow and sync in eng-platform stand if anything unexpected shows up.
